title: Jelly Jackpot
tagline: Drop silly kitchen junk on a wobbly cake. Don't be the one who topples it.
description: Each turn you open a case for a bonus, then drop a rubber chicken, a toaster or a jiggly jelly onto one shared cake tower. If it stands, you get coins. If it falls, everyone laughs at you. Guess on your friends' drops for extra coins.
howToPlay: On your turn, press Space to open a case and get a bonus (like ×2 coins).
Move the mouse over the cake and click to drop your piece.
Tower stands: you win coins. Tower falls: you lose 5.
On other players' turns, press F or G to guess if it stands (+10 if you're right).
